# Ecosystem and Tooling

Covers Dimension 1: The openapi-typescript ecosystem and alternatives.

See [citations.md](../citations.md) for full source details.

## Tool Landscape

Four major TypeScript OpenAPI client generators compete in this space. They
differ fundamentally in architecture: some generate types only, others generate
full runtime code.

### openapi-typescript Ecosystem

A three-layer pipeline [1][2]:

1. **openapi-typescript** — generates TypeScript type declarations (`.d.ts`)
   from OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML/JSON specs. No runtime code. [1]
2. **openapi-fetch** — 6 KB minified fetch wrapper that infers types from the
   generated declarations. 300k ops/s for GET requests. [1]
3. **openapi-react-query** — 1 KB wrapper around @tanstack/react-query that
   chains through openapi-fetch. [2]

Key architectural choice: type-only generation. The runtime cost is only the
openapi-fetch wrapper (6 KB), not generated client code. [1]

Available React Query hooks: useQuery, useMutation, useSuspenseQuery,
useInfiniteQuery, queryOptions. [2]

Platform support: browsers with Fetch API, Node.js 18+, TypeScript 4.7+
(5.0+ recommended). [1]

### orval

Full code generation tool, v8 current. [6]

Generates: type-safe API clients, framework-native hooks, MSW mock handlers
with Faker.js data, and type definitions. [6]

Framework support: React Query, Vue Query, Svelte Query, Solid Query, SWR,
Angular. HTTP clients: Fetch, Axios. Additional integrations: Hono, MSW, Zod,
MCP. [6]

### hey-api (@hey-api/openapi-ts)

Fork of the deprecated openapi-typescript-codegen. Full code generation with
a plugin architecture. [3][5]

Plugin ecosystem [3]:
- **Validation:** Valibot, Zod, Ajv, Arktype, Joi, Superstruct, TypeBox, Yup
- **State management:** Pinia Colada, TanStack Query, SWR, Zustand
- **Mocking:** Chance, Faker, Falso, MSW, Nock, Supertest
- **HTTP clients:** Fetch, Axios, Ky, Angular, Next.js, Nuxt, OFetch

Notable users: Vercel, OpenCode, PayPal. [3]

Generated file structure: types.gen.ts, services.gen.ts, schemas.gen.ts. [5]

### swagger-typescript-api

Uses Eta template engine for customizable output. Supports Fetch and Axios.
Download data could not be reliably obtained — the npmtrends query used
an incorrect package name (swagger-typescript-api-generator). [25]

## Comparison Matrix

| Feature | openapi-typescript | orval | hey-api | swagger-typescript-api |
|---------|-------------------|-------|---------|----------------------|
| Approach | Type-only + runtime wrapper | Full codegen | Full codegen (plugins) | Full codegen (templates) |
| Bundle impact | 6 KB (openapi-fetch) [1] | Varies by generated code | Flat SDK tree-shakeable [4] | Varies |
| React Query | openapi-react-query (1 KB) [2] | Built-in hooks [6] | TanStack Query plugin [3] | Manual |
| Vue/Svelte/Solid | Via openapi-fetch [1] | Vue/Svelte/Solid Query [6] | Pinia Colada [3] | - |
| Angular | - | Built-in [6] | Plugin [3] | - |
| Validation | openapi-ts-router (Zod, Valibot) [11] | Zod [6] | 8 validators [3] | - |
| Mocking | mockResponses() helper [11] | MSW + Faker [6] | 6 mock tools [3] | - |
| Tree-shaking | N/A (types only) | - | Flat SDK (default) [4] | - |
